titulo: Why is there a wet spot on my ceiling?

frases.texto: Why is there a wet spot on my ceiling?
That ring is where the water fell. It ran along the wood first.
On a dry day, with the air conditioner on, slime has clogged its drain, and the pan is spilling.
Stay out from under a bulge. Water on a light? Don't touch the switch.
Turn the air conditioner off. That stops new water.
Outside, seal a shop vac on the little white pipe and pull the slime out.
Don't push it in with a hose. Later, half a cup of white vinegar down the line. Never with bleach.
Wet after rain, under a bathroom, or still sagging? Stay off the roof and call a pro.
